title: Paris Lion:
title_short: Paris Lion · See You in Washington
headline: A French Lion at her first convention meets Atdhe at his first convention, and invites everyone to the next one.
story: In the packed convention arena, a French Lion in a blue and gold scarf is asked if she is happy. “Yeah!” Atdhe says it is his first convention. “Yes, me too.” She gives her advice for a first convention, then says she will see everyone in Washington next year. Her friends crowd in: “Proud to be a Lion.”

This is a convention-focused cut on purpose. Jacqui asked for a handful of Hong Kong cuts that talk about the convention itself, to promote the Washington, DC convention. This footage fits that set, not the evergreen set. The friendship beat is “me too” and the group of friends at the end.
do: Open on her big smile in the arena, with <q>Are you happy?</q> as top text on frame 1.
Make “Yes, me too” land. That is the friendship moment.
Let “see you in Washington next year” breathe. It is the reason this cut exists.
End on the group shouting “proud to be a Lion” and the selfie.
Check every caption by ear. The audio may be French.
dont: Never use 01:12–01:41. That part is a different Lion who says she is from Taiwan. Leave her out completely.
Don't zoom on stage screens or banners.
No name super. We do not have her name.
